name: bk_exp03_smoke
title: With the J-space removed from the push, only the NLA still follows the feature (toy, n=40 pairs)
caption: Pipeline smoke test on a toy in-J feature (French vs German, 40 content-matched pairs, 80 items): the layer-42 activation is pushed along the class-mean direction at the q99 dose, either full or with the top-384 J-space removed, and each reader's two-candidate log-odds is scored by AUROC (mean of 3 templates; 95% CI, 2,000 pair-clustered bootstraps). Labels in the dark bars: share of items (paired win) whose log-odds moved toward the pushed class. Oracle Lens and the J-lens move against the push. Caveat: plumbing check, not a result; the feature is trivially present in the text.
